requirements.text: When the first valid AebCommand frame is received, the AebMonitor shall enter MONITORING and check that command.
While in MONITORING, the AebMonitor shall grant the permit and report the E2E counter of the last AebCommand that passed every check as the approved counter.
If an AebCommand requests more than 8.1 m/s2, or more than 4.1 m/s2 in PARTIAL_BRAKE, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason REQUEST_LIMIT.
If an AebCommand requests braking in a state other than PARTIAL_BRAKE or FULL_BRAKE, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason REQUEST_OUTSIDE_BRAKING.

If braking starts while no valid radar target at most 150 m ahead and at most 2.1 m from the lane centre approaches with a time to collision of 2.1 s or less, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason UNJUSTIFIED_BRAKING.

If a deceleration above 4.1 m/s2 is first requested while no such target approaches with a time to collision of 1.5 s or less, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason UNJUSTIFIED_FULL_BRAKING.
If braking continues while no valid radar target at most 150 m ahead and at most 2.1 m from the lane centre is present, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason UNJUSTIFIED_BRAKING.
If in MONITORING no valid AebCommand frame is received for 60 ms, then the AebMonitor shall enter SAFE_STATE with reason COMMAND_TIMEOUT.
While in SAFE_STATE, the AebMonitor shall withdraw the permit and report the reason of the first violation until the next power cycle.
The AebMonitor shall send the AebMonitorStatus message every 20 ms with E2E protection.

tests.name: S01_AJustifiedBrakingCascadeIsApprovedUntilTheVehicleHasStopped
tests.scenario: A justified braking cascade is approved until the vehicle has stopped

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 50 km/h
And a stationary vehicle stands 22 m ahead
And the AEB controller is in STANDBY with 0 m/s2 braking
When 0.1 s pass
Then the monitor state is MONITORING
And the permit is granted
When the AEB controller is in PARTIAL_BRAKE with 4 m/s2 braking
And 0.1 s pass
Then the actuator applies -4.0 m/s2
When the AEB controller is in FULL_BRAKE with 8 m/s2 braking
And 3 s pass
Then the monitor never entered SAFE_STATE
And the actuator applied every command
And the actuator applies -8.0 m/s2
And no collision occurred
And the ego vehicle has stopped
And every monitor frame passed the E2E check
And one monitor frame was sent per 20 ms
